description: Asset Provenance Ledger - Commercial Provenance Tracking for UE5.8.2 Co-op Game

creator.description: Name of the creator (human or organization)

ai_tool_used.description: AI model or tool used (e.g., 'Midjourney v6', 'GitHub Copilot', 'None')

model_version.description: Specific version of the AI/tool used

generation_date.description: Date when the asset was generated/created

source.description: Origin source (URL, file path, organization, or 'original')

commercial_use_status.description: Commercial use approval status. UNKNOWN automatically means NOT_APPROVED_FOR_SHIPPING

modifications.description: List of modifications made to the asset

original_source_files.description: Paths or URLs to original source files

shipping_approval.description: Shipping approval record. Auto-rejected if commercial_use_status is UNKNOWN

validation_rules.unknown_license_auto_reject: If license is 'UNKNOWN' or commercial_use_status is 'UNKNOWN', shipping_approval.approved must be false
validation_rules.date_format: All dates must be ISO 8601 format
